Our Farms
Fremont Farms of Iowa ® is a premier producer of high-quality liquid egg products based in Iowa. Our family-owned farms include state-of-the-art cage free and conventional pullet and layer barns, a dedicated on-site feed mill with grain storage, and an inline egg processing facility.

Our Products
We are a leading producer of liquid egg products for the global food industry. Our farm produces liquid whole eggs, egg yolks, and egg whites. Our farm ensures our customers have access to top quality liquid egg products that are fresh, safe, and reliable.

Our Values
Fremont Farms of Iowa ® is dedicated to providing a positive work environment for our employees, protecting the health and welfare of our flocks, supporting local farmers who supply us grain, and preserving the environment for future generations to come.
Liquid Egg Production
Eggs are one of nature’s most nutritious and versatile foods. The great state of Iowa is one of the top egg-producing states in the country, and Fremont Farms of Iowa is proud to be a key part of Iowa’s vibrant and sustainable Ag economy. We supply our customers with both cage-free and conventional liquid eggs.
We process millions of eggs each day that are safe, convenient and affordable, and used by our customers in a variety of food service offerings. Learn more about our eggs and their nutritional benefits.
About Our Eggs
Our Farms
Our integrated operations include modern housing for our pullets and egg-laying hens, a dedicated feed mill with grain storage, and an egg breaking facility.
Pullet Farm
Young hens are called pullets. We acquire baby chicks one day after hatch and raise them with care during the early months of their lives at our pullet farm.
LEARN MORE
Layer Farm
Our hens are raised in modern barns on our layer farm, where we go to great lengths to ensure their health, well-being, and lifetime care.
LEARN MORE
Processing Facility
In our state-of-the-art egg processing facility, we carefully sanitize, break, and separate every egg for further processing by our valued customers.
LEARN MORE
Our Values
Since Fremont Farms of Iowa ® was founded in 1998, we have operated with the goal of doing the right thing for our people, poultry, community, and environment.
LEARN ABOUT OUR VALUES
Grain Purchasing
Fremont Farms of Iowa supports its local farmers by purchasing corn and soybeans for delivery year-round. Grain crops grown in fields near our farm are purchased from many key local farmers and used to make the nutrient rich feed we provide our pullet and layer flocks.
To become a valued grain supplier, please contact the scale house at 641-528-3447, ext. 216.
